questions.q: In what order do you tune a plane in ArduPlane?
questions.explain: Inner loops before outer loops: a poor pitch loop looks like poor TECS.

questions.q: How do you check surface reversals before flying in FBWA?
options: Move the sticks in MANUAL and watch the surfaces
Tilt the plane: the surfaces oppose the tilt
Look at the throttle level in the log
questions.explain: In a stabilized mode the surfaces must counter the tilt; a mistake is a crash on launch.

questions.q: When does AUTOTUNE save P and D?
questions.explain: P and D when an axis finishes, FF and I when you leave the mode.

options: The maximum aileron servo speed in deg/s
The time constant of the roll response
questions.explain: Within τ the plane covers ~63% of the demanded angle; the default is 0.5 s.

options: Calculate it from mass, thrust, and wing area
Measure the climb at THR_MAX in FBWA
questions.explain: The TECS limits are measured with test flights; on electric planes, at the end of the battery.

questions.q: Altitude oscillates in LOITER and pitch is tuned. What do you adjust?
questions.explain: Altitude oscillation is fixed with TECS_TIME_CONST, then TECS_PTCH_DAMP.

questions.q: The plane weaves after every turn in AUTO. What do you do?
questions.explain: Weaving means L1 is too sharp; for sluggish turns do the opposite and decrease it by 5.

questions.q: Why do you fit a rangefinder for automatic landing?
options: The barometer does not work at low altitude
Barometer altitude error is in meters
NAV_LAND is not accepted without one
questions.explain: A baro error of several meters makes the flare a lottery; RNGFND_LANDING = 1 makes it repeatable.
